Pinned revision: e15fc0de25fab983e3e42bac8798be69a85c23bf

The application vendors 28 regular SVG assets and 7 color SVG assets.
Regular silhouettes are normalized to the application's 32-unit artboard and use the control foreground.
Color assets are converted to native WPF vector drawings with their original gradients and opacity.
The original SVGs, source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are retained under Assets/Icons/Fluent.
The upstream color variant is deprecated. These selected, MIT-licensed assets are pinned locally.
No upstream trademarks or platform logos are supplied by this icon collection.
The application icon and eight platform source illustrations remain original product artwork.
